description: We are Team Junior Astronauts from Ampara, Sri Lanka. We are building a fun game to help kids learn about space, the Moon, and Mars. We love games, storytelling, and space exploration. Our team is complete.
summary: Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer is a fun survival game for kids. Players must survive 7 days in space by balancing Oxygen, Power, Food, and Shield. They can grow plants, fix solar panels, and complete daily missions to learn how real astronauts live in space. I used Meta AI to help with coding and ideas.
details: Our game is Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer. The player is a junior astronaut who must survive 7 days on a space station. The game has 4 main meters: Oxygen, Power, Food, and Shield. If any meter becomes zero, the game is over. The player can do actions like Grow Plants to get Food and Oxygen, Fix Solar Panels to get Power, and Repair Shield to stay safe. Every day there is a new mission to complete. We used HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to build this game. We used Meta AI to help with coding and ideas. This project helps kids learn how hard it is to live in space and how astronauts solve problems.
